_comment: WF2 (vision-build) capability manifest for SAPPHIRE. Gates run through bin/wf_gate.sh because this repo has no flat repo-root pytest — each app module runs in its own uv .venv. Touched modules: iEasyHydroForecast, preprocessing_runoff, forecast_dashboard, linear_regression. {testIgnore} = pytest --ignore flags for the milestone's not-yet-passing locked tests (repo-relative paths); the dispatcher passes them to every module pytest (non-matching ignores are harmless). Coverage/mutation/typecheck/SAST are intentionally omitted for this first real run to avoid multi-venv tooling friction — add later once green.

lockedTestExclusion.note: pytest --ignore=<repo-relative path>; dispatcher forwards {testIgnore} to each module venv
